title: One-plug umbilical
lede: Blue Fiberon PET-GF15 plug and socket in a black enclosure receiver. A packed insulated entry feeds curved tube guides and a straight mating nose. Compression, grip and retention require physical trials.

panels.name: Machine side
panels.caption: Flush in back-top: a 47.0 x 44.6 face on a 2.5 mm side ledge, held from inside by two snap leaves.

panels.name: Plug
panels.caption: Ø34 rear body, 98 mm long: 15 mm fabric cuff, 45 mm curved transition and 38 mm straight nose. One blue key retains the four tubes.

panels.name: Plugged in
panels.caption: The plug runs 7.7 mm into the 34 mm cup before a stub reaches its hole. The bars meet face to face.

panels.name: Release
panels.caption: FLAVOR-B over DRAIN. Each union floats 1.83 mm: a pull drags it forward until its collet lands on the floor's back face and lets go. Side shows the cut.

panels.name: Through the counter
panels.caption: The Ø34 rigid boot in the 1⅜″ countertop hole: 0.465 mm nominal radial clearance. The loose foam and braid need compression during passage.

panels.name: Boot materials
panels.caption: The cut follows the soda tube. Foam continues into the first half of its curved guide; the fabric tucks 15 mm into the cuff. A chamfered shoulder marks the seated depth, with 64 mm of boot outside the port.

panels.name: Machine-side plate
panels.caption: The slicer's plate: socket on its flats, retainer, wall coupon roof-down. One pause for the socket's bars.

panels.name: Plug-side plate
panels.caption: Saved coupling trial without the guided boot: the plug upside down on its top flat and the key on end. One pause for the plug's bars.
